cash_feature_definitions.debt_coverage: (mean historical clean monthly receipts - mean historical operating cash outflows)/(existing+new monthly loan payments); payments>0
cash_feature_definitions.receipts_growth: mean receipts of last3historicalmonths / mean receipts of preceding3historicalmonths -1; raw percentage divided100
cash_feature_definitions.receipts_cv: std(ddof0) of12historical monthly receipts / mean; raw percentage divided100
cash_feature_definitions.cash_buffer_months: opening cash reserve / (mean monthly operating cash outflows + existing monthly debtservice + new monthly debtservice)
cash_feature_definitions.largest_customer_share: simulated largest share of customer receipts, raw percentage divided100
cash_feature_definitions.cash_operating_margin: (mean receipts - mean operating cash outflows)/mean receipts

simulation.monetary_scale: sampled historical RFSD revenue/12; bounds100000..20000000RUB/month are simulator assumptions, not actual2026 borrower revenues
simulation.receipts_volatility: lognormal median.12,log-sd.45, clipped[.04,.45]; independent monthly lognormal innovations adjusted to mean1.
simulation.cash_margin: clipped sampled RFSD net_margin[-.10,.25] +Normal(.08,.04), final clip[-.05,.45]; explicitly a proxy+assumption, not equality of net profit and cashflow.
simulation.operating_costs: Costs use fixed/variable components. Variable share Uniform(.35,.8); remaining fixed. Monthly independent cost noise sd.03; future fixed-cost inflation.003/month is a simulation setting, not a macro forecast.
simulation.customer_concentration: .1+.75*Beta(2,5); largest-customer share influences size of an exogenous future receipts loss.
simulation.reserve: (mean historical operating outflows + existing monthly debtservice) * clip(lognormal(log(.9),1.15),.03,6) months. Borrower PD buffer feature includes NEW loan service in denominator; benchmark reserve distribution does not. Approximate US marginal benchmark13/27/62days, not Russia calibration.
simulation.debtservice: existing monthly service=mean receipts*Uniform(0,.07); NEW monthly service=mean receipts*Uniform(.01,.10); no dependence on future target.
simulation.future_shock: 10% of borrowers independently get a shock month Uniform1..9. Persistent receipts loss proportional to largest-customer share; cap loss at80%. This probability is an expert simulation setting.
simulation.emergency_liquidity: A one-off optional owner liquidity line related to nonnegative latent source equity/assets may be implemented only if its exact formula is frozen in generator metadata before fitting; otherwise omit.
simulation.repayment_waterfall: Opening reserve + monthly operating cashflow. Unfunded operating shortfalls carry forward. Any available cash next pays prior operating shortfalls and existing loan service, then NEW-loan overdue/current installments FIFO, remainder retained. No negative available cash spent. Store monthly due/paid/arrears/cash for independent replay.
simulation.label_generation: Before each month_end payment, inspect prior unpaid installments: calendar-day age>=90 sets absorbing default=1, even if cured at that payment. Then settle FIFO and retain after-payment ledger. Independently of any fitted/expert PD equation; never condition generated history on final y.
simulation.all_assumptions: Parameters above are scenario settings. They are not estimated Russian IP default mechanisms or banking PD calibration.

validations: No real outcome column used in generation; independent deterministic regeneration by seed; disjoint source-group splits.
Replay at least100 entire monthly repayment paths independently, including forced90+ and cure boundary cases; verify calendar-day threshold.
Feature extraction from historical months only. New payment and opening reserve known at baseline. No future cashflow/default information in predictors.
Compare financial marginal distributions with sampled source and existing Kaggle benchmarks without claiming validation of Russian IP cashflows or credit PD.
Stress checks with same future innovations: more cash reserve cannot cause earlier default; increasing new-loan payment cannot improve repayment.
Held-out synthetic AUC/Gini/KS/PR/calibration plus recovery/conditional checks. Do not tune simulator to a desired test Gini.
